title: Analytic Metadata CIM
description: Append-only ledger of iterative changes made to an analytic by Adler. One row per improvement (PK metadata_id), inserted deployment-side when a run carries an Adler improvement not yet recorded. analytic_id joins to analytic_runs.analytic_id and analytic_results.analytic_id. 'Latest' state is a MAX(improvement_seq)/MAX(improvement_dtg) query; per-run execution history lives in analytic_runs.

input.title: Analytic Metadata CIM Input Schema
input.description: Standard analytic input contract (shared with analytic_runs/analytic_results); included so the document validates standalone.

start_dtg.description: Inclusive UTC start of the data window.

end_dtg.description: Exclusive UTC end of the data window.

output.title: Analytic Metadata CIM Output Schema
output.description: One Adler improvement event. Append grain: one row per (analytic_id, improvement_seq).

metadata_id.description: PRIMARY KEY. Deterministic hash of analytic_id + improvement_seq, so re-recording the same improvement is a no-op (idempotent append).

analytic_id.description: Canonical namespaced analytic id (e.g. armory.oks.t1112) from .scaffold/analytic_registry.yml. JOIN KEY -> analytic_runs.analytic_id and analytic_results.analytic_id.

analytic_version.description: Analytic version produced by this improvement.

analytic_url.description: URL to the analytic source/rendered page.

analytic_path.description: Repo-relative path to the analytic notebook.

improvement_seq.description: 1-based ordinal of this Adler improvement for the analytic (0 = baseline/initial deployment with no Adler change).

improvement_dtg.description: UTC timestamp of the DEVELOPMENT-side Adler improvement.

improvement_username.description: User who ran the Adler improvement on the dev side.

model.description: Model Adler used for this improvement (e.g. claude-opus-4-8).

improvement_version.description: Version tag this improvement produced (mirrors analytic_version when set).

adler_version.description: Version of Adler that made the change.

execution_dtg.description: UTC timestamp of the DEPLOYMENT-side run that recorded this improvement row.

execution_username.description: Deployment user/service account for the recording run.

execution_run_id.description: run_id of the recording run -> joins to analytic_runs/analytic_results.

execution_branch.description: Git branch deployed at the recording run.

execution_commit_hash.description: Git commit deployed at the recording run.

emitted_dtg.description: UTC timestamp the row was written.
